eps.o: The ballroom welcomes 16 new celebrities for their first live performance; the male celebrities make their debut, performing to a number one song from the year they were born.
The female celebrities make their competition debut, performing to a number one song from the year they were born.
The 14 remaining couples hit the dance floor with performances inspired by some of the biggest viral hits and unforgettable moments that have taken the internet by storm.
Thirteen remaining couples cruise into "Yacht Rock Night," with performances set to smooth grooves, soft-rock classics and iconic hits that defined the yacht rock era.

The ballroom turns up the star power as the 12 remaining couples take on "Mariah Carey Night," with the celebrities and their pro partners dancing to the iconic songs from the legendary singer-songwriter.
The remaining 11 couples perform songs made famous by some of the most iconic Super Bowl performances throughout the years. Sportscaster Joe Buck joins as a guest judge.

The ballroom gets personal as the 10 remaining couples take to the dance floor to deliver heartfelt performances honoring the influential people and places that have shaped their lives. Guest judge Kym Johnson returns to offer her expert insights.
